topics.title: Pluperfect Tense (Plus-que-parfait) Formation & Antecedency
topics.objective: Construct and use the pluperfect tense (*imparfait* of auxiliary + past participle) to establish temporal antecedency between two past events.

topics.title: Pluperfect Agreement Rules & Type 3 Conditionals (Si + Plus-que-parfait)
topics.objective: Apply past participle agreement rules in pluperfect constructions and formulate counterfactual hypothetical sentences (Conditionnel Type 3).

topics.title: Future Perfect (Futur Antérieur) Formation & Chronological Aspect
topics.objective: Form and apply the future perfect tense (*futur simple* of auxiliary + past participle) to denote actions that will be completed prior to a specified future moment or event.

topics.title: Future Perfect with Temporal Conjunctions (Quand, Dès que, Lorsque)
topics.objective: Apply the obligatory double-future rule in French temporal subordinate clauses using *quand, lorsque, dès que, aussitôt que, une fois que*.
